Name: Riverdale - Jughead's Beanie
Author: RetroRed
Description: Surprised at the complete lack of Riverdale or even just Archie related mods for Stardew Valley, seems like the kind of game that would have a lot. Anyway its just Jughead's beanie added as a new hat using Json Assets so that mod is required, I guess I'll make a content patcher version to replace the normal beanie if people want it. Made it for myself but decided to share it, lmk what you guys think.

Manifest.Name: Jughead's Beanie
Manifest.Description: Smells like burgers, wearing it gives you an urge to wear S t-shirts
Manifest.Author: Monochrome
